decisions.requiredExports: Main decided: full runs require ALL THIRTEEN names, fixture runs keep the existing rule (ABI minus parse_with_fuel and emit_library_start) = 11. C exports are never exempted for convenience. The original ten remain covered.
decisions.runtimeString: Main approved runtime: String as an explicit CBackend API argument (loaded runtime SOURCE bytes, not a path), and confirmed it is not a duplicate passive carrier: the single-carrier rule forbids nominal SourceFile copies, not a primitive String parameter. The host must still authenticate the actual runtime file hash it read.
decisions.legacyCBackend: Read the field's real semantics before touching it: it means 'the legacy AST C backend is not in use'. The new c_emit seam is a new backend, so the flag STAYS false; the gate now carries legacyCBackendMeans to say so explicitly.
decisions.criterionWording: Updated the full-run criterion to the full native validated closure plus byte-identical JS (the JS byte fixed point) plus full semantic AST oracle parity, and stated in the criterion that C emission is not exercised by this lane.
decisions.cSurfaceFields: The gate now reports cSurface from observed root text only: which C exports are required, whether the seam import is present, which C wrappers exist, and emissionExercised (false unless a lane really ran C). Declared exports alone never become a C behaviour claim; that belongs to FIRAcceptance's authenticated C fixture rows.
decisions.ownership: Main applies other branches' merges; I own ABI/generation/report wording and the single fresh full root pass after the C module lands.
